depiction.primary_object: two horizontal lines representing list items
depiction.composition: two rows with text lines on the left and status marks on the right

readings.meaning: pros and cons comparison or evaluation

ambiguity: Closely resembles generic checklist or to-do list icons where the marks are on the left side.
task_intents: take a practice quiz or test
write a pros and cons list
complete a safety or compliance audit

example_tasks.task: Take the online defensive driving quiz to get the insurance discount
Write out pros and cons of refinancing the mortgage right now
Sort through the contractor bids and mark which ones meet our specs
Score the Tuesday night pub trivia sheets from round three
Go through the landlord move-out inspection checklist room by room
Approve or reject pending expense claims in the team portal
Finish the 20-question boating safety test before Saturday
Review the practice questions I got wrong
Go over Leo's graded math test together and redo the three problems he missed
Run the WCAG accessibility audit on the checkout page and log every pass or fail
Weigh the pros and cons of keeping the old Honda versus trading it in this spring

example_tasks_es: Hacer el test de práctica de la DGT antes del viernes
Anotar pros y contras de mudarnos al piso del centro
Corregir los exámenes de sintaxis de 3º ESO
example_tasks_ru: Пройти пробный тест ПДД по билетам без ошибок
Выписать плюсы и минусы обоих детских садов у дома
Проверить контрольные работы за вторую четверть

context_tasks.task: Buy red pens for grading midterms
Email the landlord the signed move-out inspection form
Book a quiet study room for the practice exam
Call Aunt Linda to see if they're coming to the rehearsal dinner

near_misses.task: Check if the back door is locked before bed
Schedule annual eye exam with Dr. Patel
Pack the camping gear checklist into the trunk
Buy No. 2 pencils and a calculator
Test the smoke detector batteries in the hallway
Order a certified copy of our marriage license

reasoning: The two lines paired with a checkmark and an X clearly convey evaluation: right vs. wrong (quizzes, grading), yes vs. no (RSVPs, approvals), or pros vs. cons. It fits tasks centered on tests, audits, and decision lists, though at a quick glance it can be confused with a standard to-do checklist icon.
